mechanism: Propylthiouracil reduces thyroid hormone synthesis; hyperthyroidism increases beta-adrenergic sensitivity and catecholamine effects, which atenolol counteracts, but as PTU normalizes thyroid function, beta-blockade effects may become excessive.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and thyroid function regularly; adjust atenolol dose as thyroid status normalizes during PTU therapy to avoid bradycardia or hypotension.
